It was a normal day;, Mystery Incorporated was taking a day off from all the hard work they’ve put into their newly bought bar. Fred and Daphne were behind the counter, and Velma was in the fireplace... You know, the usual. But that all changed when a familiar face appeared in the doorway… the stranger had the face of Shaggy himself. I mean, Shaggy was just trying to tell a story to his friends! But this guy- No, this thing turned them into horrific monsters. The gang abandoned Shaggy, they left him in the hot sand of the desert, c. Called him names, and replaced him withfor The Stranger., It wasit was almost like The Stranger brainwashed them. H, he destroyed the world with some kind of horrible infection, and everyone's corpses rotted and oozed with a vile black liquid as they rose back from the dead as one of them... So after the tragedy, Shaggy lived alone in his lab, waiting for it all to end. He was worthless without the gang. And they were right, Shaggy was weak and useless. Then Shaggy thought of Scooby. Come to think of it, where even was Scooby? Shaggy could’ve sworn he saw him at the bar- Suddenly there was a knock at the door… And Shaggy was thrown into a journey, a quest of which he never even dreamed of accomplishing. With his new acquaintance, Gromit, by his side, they were unstoppable. Shaggy and Gromit travel through deserts, oceans, caves, labs, towns, and infinitely expanding dimensions? Shaggy fights to save the world, to save his own life. And more importantly, find Scooby. He learns to control the power he never knew he had, while also fighting to keep his own sanity. Chapter 1

Mystery of the Big-Dick Stick

2,667 words
"So I walk into the place, right?"

Scooby is already chuckling.

"Hold on, hold on, wait for it. So get this, the guy wanted 50 dollars for his "Groovy Dooby Doobies", and I was like 'cincuenta dólares?? Hell nah man'"

Scooby absolutely LOSES his shit, curled up on the floor wheezing. Shaggy chuckles nervously. Shaggy takes a hit off the bong, he holds it.... holds it... then elegantly puffs the smoke into a giant mushroom cloud.

He passes the bong to Scooby, who's still laughing, and he inhales for about 5 seconds then immediately cracks up again, coughing simultaneously.

A giant pillar of smoke drifts out of the sunroof into the night air. Bob Marley hums low through the van's speakers.

Inside his tent, Fred stares at the ceiling. Listening. Waiting, like maybe this is the moment they finally stop laughing at the SAME joke, retold.

Scooby wheezes again.

Fred closes his eyes.

"God..."

They've been doing this all night long...

"They're STILL up?"

He sits up.

"WOULD YOU GUYS GO TO SLEEP ALREADY?" Fred said firmly, raising his voice.

"Oh shit — Scoob. Act natural."


"RAGGY. It's the rolice. It's the ROLICE—"


"Nahhh Scooby it's Fred"


"SAME THING!!!!"


"You guys do realize we have to be up by six o'clock, right!?" Daphne snapped,

"Like scoob, we should totally sneak out dude"

"Reah! Reah!"

Daphne groaned and pulled her pillow over her head.

Across from her, Velma lets out a long, exaggerated sigh, clearly pissed the fuck off.

The dying campfire lets out a tiny crackle. Crickets. The low sound of a stream somewhere nearby.

And something else... Like a tree swaying in the wind.

But the only wind tonight is from Scooby's lungs, and he's somehow STILL laughing his ass off over Shaggy's half-baked joke.

Once the laughing died out, Scooby and Shaggy fled the scene.

*Click* Shaggy turned on his flashlight. It flickered; the battery hummed. It was a professional-grade flashlight made specifically for mystery solving. It was not used for mystery solving. It was used for times when Scooby and Shaggy get so high out of their minds they decide to explore a creepy forest together. 

Shaggy points his flashlight at a patch of moss on the tree in front of him. A slight rustle of the bushes behind him. Shaggy turns around to investigate but is interrupted as Scooby exclaims from behind another bush somewhere,

"Raggy, a clue, a clue!"

Shaggy set his flashlight down on a tree stump, and marched over to Scooby. 

"Like, what'dya find Scoob?"

Scooby turns to Shaggy and his gaze widens. He goes silent.

"What is it pal?"

Scooby stammers,

"R-R-R-R-R-Raggy..... R-R-Ronster!!"

"What monster Scoob? I don't see a monster."

A shadow looms over Shaggy behind him, cast by the dim flashlight. lightning strikes. It starts raining. Shaggy sees the giant figure towering over behind him. Shaggy shudders, then yelps

"ZOINKS!"

Scooby jumps into Shaggy's arms and they bolt it to the mystery machine. They can hardly see in the pitch black darkness. Somehow their path led them straight back to the monster, Shaggy's feet skid against the wet dirt, Lightning again. The monster has glowing red eyes, a crooked twig nose, and a sinister smile, laughing at their fear.

Shaggy and Scooby split up, running in different directions. Shaggy runs behind a tree. The monster follows. Scooby comes out of a bush and runs straight into Shaggy, and into his arms.

At this point, Fred and the gang were fed up with whatever the hell these two were doing. So they get up and go investigate. They find a broken flashlight on a tree stump. Velma picks it up,

"These idiots! Do they know how much a replacement would be? This lighting apparatus was made SPECIFICALLY for mystery solving! Its professional grade! The premium package! They can't just-" 

"Velma shut up for one minute." groaned Fred. "Look, we're all tired. Let's just go find them so we can go to bed."

"Freddie, its 2:00 in the morning, we wont get any sleep anyways"

"*sigh* You're right, well, you know the drill. Lets split up, Daphne - you come with-"

"I go with you, Velma goes alone, and Scooby and Shaggy just be themselves. Yeah. We know Fred"

Fred gasped, clutching his chest.

"Well o-kay then, if you dont want to go with me so bad, fine! hmph, I didn't want to go with you anyways. Matter of fact--Velma, you're comin' with me."

"Are you kidding me right now? Is your ego that fragile!?"

"Daph, you have no idea how much I do for you, I think you should show me a bit more respect!"

"Fred, you're an egocentric, narcissistic jerk! I'm going with Daphne for a change."

Velma and Daphne storm off into the woods, 

"And don't you forget! You still have to play bait Daphne!" Fred yelled after them, since he just NEEDED to get the last word in.

"Stupid Daphne... Stupid nerdy Velma always taking her side. Pfft, whatever. Fred's got this, Fred solo. Goin' commando" He muttered to himself.

Shaggy adjusted his footing on the tree, Fred jumped at the noise. 

"Like, Fred, I don't think that means what you think it means" Shaggy and Scooby chuckled.

"Wha-? Guys!?! What the hell are you doing all the way up there?"

"A monster chased us up here! You should have seen it Fred, it was big, scary, and, and-"

"Yeah yeah, sure. What I think is that you two are on a different planet right now."

"And it had a huge rhenis!"

"What..? No, Scooby-"

"That was a joke, rehehehe!"

"Oh man, you really got me good Scooby!"

"ENOUGH. You two have obviously had way too much of those... What do you call them? Doobie snacks? and now you're seeing things. There's no monster. There's never a monster. Well — there's always a monster, but not THAT kind of monster. Now get down from there, both of you."

"Actually Fred, it's a common misconception that weed causes hallucinations, according to-"

"I DONT care Shaggy. whatever you saw, it wasnt real."

Meanwhile, the girls search around a nearby cave.

"Do you really think they could be in there, Daphne?"

"Scooby and Shaggy would know better than to step foot in that creepy cave, no matter how high they are they're still chickens!"

"Yeah, but chickens dont keep you up all night--They just roost up in a tree or something."

"Hold on Velma, you might be on to something! What if they've climbed a tree or something?"

"I just said that, Daphne"

"Hold on, do you hear that?"

Fred was yelling at Scooby and Shaggy in the distance.

"I DONT CARE IF THERE'S A MONSTER, GET DOWN HERE--NOW!!! HOW DID YOU EVEN GET UP THERE? HOW HIGH ARE YOU!?"

"No Fred, it's 'Hi, how are you?' 'I'm fine, how are you?"

Daphne turns to look at Velma, but to her surprise she had vanished!

"Velma? Where'd you go, hey! This isn't funny Velma where are you?"

She turns around, and is met face to face with the monster, she screams, she runs.

This gets the guys' attention, 

"Daphne..? Oh god! Daphne, I have to go save her!"

Fred runs off into the darkness, leaving Scooby and shaggy still up in the tree. Fred-- completely blind in the dark--stumbles into his own trap. He's immediately tangled up in a net, 20 something feet up in the air, screaming for help.

"SCOOBY, SHAGGY, velma.... i guess.... SOMEONE! HELP ME!"

The monster hears this commotion, and charges towards Fred's direction, stepping on the shattered glass off the professional-grade lighting apparatus, it yelps in pain, and trips over a rock onto a tree stump.

*Thump*

Just like that, the scary monster was taken out.

"Ugh, my hair is ruined. Ive got like 80% sticks and twigs and 20% dirt and rocks. This is the worst night EVER!"

"Daphne, we have bigger things to worry about. Do you not see how structurally unsound this cage is? Jinkies, even the three little piggies could blow this thing down."

"Blow it down then, piggy."

Velma slowly turns around.

"What did you just call me? Get over here you bitch!"

Velma lunges at Daphne, taking the cage down with her. But their tussle is interrupted by the monster letting out a hurt moan, and shuffling a bit. They both stop and look up at the monster, the broken flashlight flickering brighter than it probably should.

"Shit--tie it up!"

They both panic and reluctantly help each other tie the monster up, the flashlight has now stopped flickering, and has caught fire to the tree monsters branches. Now they are both screaming, tying it up and putting the fire out simultaneously.

Fred is still screaming in the distance, his voice getting hoarse.

"Why... Why does this happen to me? Tell me trap, what have I done to deserve this?!! I brought you into this world and i can take you out of it! Take this!"

Fred does.... something... Hes flailing his limbs about, trying to escape. He sees Daphne hesitantly walking over to help. 

"Oh no... not YOU.." grumbled Fred.

"What? I'm trying to help. You don't want me to help?"

"NO, in fact, I DON'T want you to help me."

"Fine that's just not my problem then."

"Wait- no, Daphne- WAIT. I didn't mean it. Let me down from here!" 

Velma sighed, and called the sheriff, while Fred gives Daphne horrible and specific instructions. 

✦ ✦ ✦

News reporters arrive at the scene, asking Velma questions like:

"Is the monster real?"

"What was its motive?"

"Did it have a big penis?"

"Who's under the mask?"

Velma- in response to each question, just shrugs and shakes her head, while Daphne is arguing with the firemen cutting Fred out of his trap. 

"How long is this gonna take? The people need Fred to take off the mask!" argued Daphne. 

One of the firemen tries to respond but is interrupted by Fred,

"You know, its YOUR fault I'm in this pickle in the first place!"

"Oh, MY fault? That's funny, I remember you choosing to go with Velma instead of me!"

"Oh, would you two quit bickering? I'm just gonna take the mask off myself."

Velma reaches to pull the mask of for film. But, to her surprise, the monster takes his own mask off. It turns out, the guy inside just wanted an autograph, and to be on live television. Velma sighs.

Scooby and Shaggy walk out of the mystery machine behind them. A puff of smoke erupts from within. Scooby falls to the ground, unconscious, Shaggy looks at the news reporters with his bloodshot eyes, throws up a peace sign, and blinks slowly.

✦ ✦ ✦

Shaggy and Scooby slept through breakfast, lunch, and almost dinner. But their stomachs woke them up. The news on TV is talking about "Scooby 'Doobie' Doo and the mystery of the big-dick stick".

"Rehehehe! That's embarrassing!"

"Scooby! Did you tell them to say that? You little shit." Said Fred.

"Sources are now questioning whether Mystery Incorporated's bar is a front for illegal drug activity after last night's incident in the uh.... the... the woods of... the woods. Investigators are also citing an illegal hippie-bonfire deep in the woods, and shattered glass on the grounds that children camp at. One witness claims 'I don't want these damn junkies influencing MY children!'"

"Like Fred, what's for dinner? I've got some major munchies!"

Fred gives Shaggy the death stare. This is the most intimidating he's EVER looked.

"Shaggy. It is 7:45 in the afternoon. We have been up since TWO IN THE MORNING BECAUSE OF YOU." Spat Fred.

"So, like, I guess that's a no on dinner?"

"YES SHAGGY, YES. ITS A FUCKING NO ON DINNER. IN FACT, WHY DON'T YOU GO AHEAD AND EAT THIS-"

"BREAKING NEWS! Facility in desert nearby.... the town EXPLODED | CAUSE: Unknown | FATALITIES: Completely fatal, no survivors." . . . "Authorities are advising residents to-"

Fred grabs the remote and shuts the TV off with a click, and contemplates throwing the remote at Shaggy. Right in his big stupid nose, thinks Fred. There was a moment of silence from everybody in the bar.

"Like... that's the lab a few miles north, isn't it?" says Shaggy.

"Everybody go home. bars closed." mutters Fred.

"You heard him, everyone out!" Shouted Velma.

Everyone in the bar -- well, mostly regulars. Everyone else heard the rumors and didn't bother showing up. Everyone got up and walked out,

"You guys suck!" someone heckled from the crowd.

Scooby looks down at the floor with that guilty dog look, scooting closer to Shaggy.

"You two. I want you out too. I have to close tonight and if I have to spend another second around you I will lose my mind. NOW GET OUT, both of you."

"I'm sorry Fred, I really-"

"I don't want to hear it. just get out."

"Ill close tonight, Scoob and I. It's the least I can do."

Fred just stares at Shaggy for a moment, grabs his ascot and leaves. No one else says a word. The girls leave shortly after.

"Well Scoob, whad'ya say we cook up some instant noodles?"

"With rice cream and ranchovies?"

"You know it pal."

Just as Shaggy opened his pack of noodles, in the corner of his eye he saw movement. Shaggy squinted at the corner of the room. Just the old coat rack. Just shadows. He shook his head and went back to his noodles.

"Hey Scoob, did you see something by the—"

A crash from across the bar. Scooby emerged from behind a booth with a half-eaten basket of fries hanging out of his mouth, tail wagging.

"Cleaning!" He announced proudly, gesturing at the absolutely untouched table beside him.

"...Right." Shaggy turned back to the stove. "We're gonna need ice cream for these, buddy. Check the basement?"

Scooby's ears flattened. He glanced at the basement trapdoor and then back at Shaggy with enormous, pleading eyes.

"Scooby-Doo?" Shaggy raised an eyebrow, already knowing the answer.

"...Rooby Snack?"

"We've got no Scooby Snacks, man. You know that. Velma locks those things up before 5:00, because after that we get all crazy and whatever"

Scooby sighed deeply and followed Shaggy to the trapdoor.

The hinges creaked like they hadn't been opened in a while. Which was weird, because Fred opened this thing every other day.

Shaggy descended the ladder into the dark, Shaggy reaching out blindly until his fingers found the pull-chain. He yanked it.

The chain swung lazily from the ceiling, the light flickered since it was really old. Shaggy walked over to the bulky freezer, and started rummaging around for the ice cream.

"C'mon Scoob, come down!"

"Ruh uh."

"Buddy, like, we just talked about this. Tell you what, if you come down here we can try and break into the Scooby-Snack vault? Whad'ya say pal?" Shaggy called over his shoulder, still rummaging.

The light flickered, in the corner of the room, just before the shadow swallowed it again, a figure, and then with another flicker it was gone.

Shaggy spun around.

"Scooby—"

Scooby slid from behind the door, Shaggy could hear his lifeless body being dragged above him, dust fell from the floorboards.

The trapdoor slammed shut above him with a crack that shook dust from the ceiling.
"SCOOBY! SCOOBY OPEN UP! OPEN THE DOOR — SCOOB — SOMEBODY—"
He pulled up the ladder in a frantic motion and beat both fists against the wood. It didn't budge.

The chain stopped swinging.

Then the light went out.

It was pitch black now, the kind that you can feel.

Shaggy held perfectly still, breathing hard through his nose. He closed his eyes and tried to calm himself down.

Okay. Okay. There's nothing down here. There's never anything down here. It's just the basement. It's just Fred's gross basement that smells like old beer and—

Something closed around his ankle.

A cold, bony hand.

Chapter 2

Scooby Doo, Where Are You?

3,502 words
Shaggy woke up four hours later at midnight. he was slumped in the booth closest to the basement door, a sad bowl of cold noodles sat in front of him. Shaggy assumed he must have slept all throughout the night, and Scooby left him dinner.

Shaggy got up and winced when he put pressure on his ankle. It was a bit sore. He stretched then walked it off.

Damn wooden bench, why'd they sit me upright like that anyways?

Then he lazily put his cold dinner in the microwave and pressed the +30 seconds button.

Boy am I starved. What a night, or... day. I can hardly even remember what happened after me and Scooby got lost in that cave.... I think we stepped in shit or something, that's probably why I stink.

Shaggy took his dinner out and devoured the bowl of noodles, not without adding a few "extra ingredients" first.

Shaggy sighed and rubbed his eyes.

Couldn't they have at least woken me up before they left? it's too late for this shit.

Shaggy yawned and started closing up, he cleared the tables, washed the tables, washed the dishes.... Swept... mopped... restocked the fridge. Then he hopped in his car and leaned back his head to relax for a moment. Shaggy sighed, and tried to pop his neck. His hands were all wrinkled from washing those dishes, and he was even dirtier now, since Fred refused to invest in personal hygiene, that's why everyone hates closing, because no matter how good you do it you always get dirty.


"Gosh, now I'll have to shower when I get home" Shaggy checks the time on his dash

It's already 2:00? Why didn't Scooby stay and help me... He usually crashes at my place anyways.... strange.

Shaggy cruised over to the group laboratory--Where he lives--which is funny, you'd think Velma would live there, but she say's it's 'smelly in there and there's bugs'. Shaggy and Scooby mostly use it for high-tech stoner gear, and Fred uses it to store his "experiments" (what he calls his traps that are SO inconvenient and impractical, but swears to Velma that "it could be useful one day! Think like a scientist Velma, the smartest scientists believed in traps!"). Daphne doesn't go in there at all, shes worried "all the machines and stuff will come to life" while shes alone and "hack her".

Shaggy pulled into the garage, and got out of his car. He knew he was alone, so he just took off his smelly clothes and through them into the conveniently open washer. he hopped in the shower and tried not to doze off, but he noticed that he couldn't doze off, so instead he tried to doze off. When he came to the conclusion that he wasnt going to fall back asleep, he rolled up a joint and took a can of Mtn. Dew from the fridge, and decided to go take a walk in the cool desert.

There's a nearby hiking trail up a mountain, er, its more of a hill, really. But Shaggy's not going there. Any time Shaggy's taken Scooby for a walk while they we're high enough to forget that Scooby is basically a human, They've completed every quest, side-quest, and everything in between on that trail. So Shaggy decided to go to a further away mountain, It was a harder climb but apparently the view up there is worth it. However, nobody goes there anymore after someone fell trying to climb up and broke their neck in 3 places. That was the worst thing that's ever happened in the town of.... the... uh.... the town.

 On the way there, Shaggy noticed an unusual breeze. There wasn't usually any wind this time of year, but then again he's never been on a walk sober. Shaggy looked up at the behemoth of a mountain, he clearly underestimated just how great it was. That's what it's called, by the way--"The Greatest Dune"--It's not really called that. But he and Scooby made up a name for it since nobody in this town seems to know what anything is called.

The climb up The Greatest Dune was just about as pleasant as you'd expect, there wasn't much of a trail, either. Another reason for the fat tourists who only come to see the gas station to stay away. Mtn. Dew in one hand, handful of rock in the other, grabbing onto anything he could--roots, rocks, random car junk.

How did car parts get up here anyways...? 

I guess that shower didn't really do much for Shaggy, because by the time he reached the top he was already just as or even more sweaty and dirty as he was before he took a shower.

Shaggy squinted in the dark, it was starting to get a bit brighter. It was probably around 4 o'clock by now, sun was about to rise. He could see a tiny figure sitting on the cliff. As he got closer he could see a tiny pair of boots, what he now understood to be a cat staring into the sky, kicking his legs. He wore a cavalier hat.

Shaggy instantly recognized him.

"Hey..." Shaggy panted and wiped sweat from his forehead. "Puss, in boots--right?"

"Who's asking? hm?" He replied, studying the cosmic bodies. Not even turning to face Shaggy. Which was kind of rude, but also hella aura farming low-key.

"Norville, from high school. We had.... what was it? uhhhhhh...."

"Intro to drawing, first seme-"

"Drawing! Yeah, and we both sucked at it. Good times, man. Good times." Shaggy laughed nervously.

Puss just looked at him, stared for a second, and went laid on his back, staring at the sky. He had a very distinct Spanish accent, he spoke calmly and almost as if he wanted to be left alone.

Shaggy awkwardly lied down 3 feet away from him, and tried to relax. But he couldn't stop replaying what he just said in his head.

Like, i totally just made things awkward. Let me make it up to him.

Shaggy sat up and cracked open his Mtn. Dew, which was slightly warm and shooken up from the climb, it started overflowing.

"Ah shit, god damnit." Shaggy muttered under his breath

He set it aside and it dripped down off the cliff. Shaggy looked down and immediately his heart dropped.

"Come here often?" he asked

"If you're wondering how safe it is, I assure you it can hold my weight just fine. I've heard cracks before but nothing insane" Said Puss

Shaggy stopped what he was doing, straightened his posture and stared directly at Puss. He couldn't tell if he was joking, he never could. They rarely spoke because of this. Shaggy shifted his hands to get up.

"It was a joke, my friend. lie down, enjoy the night sky. Sunrise will come very soon."

Shaggy didn't know how to respond without making it awkward again, so he took the joint out of his pocket, lit it, and lied back down.

Shaggy held the joint out towards puss, gesturing for him to take it.

Puss politely declined with a shake of his head. Shaggy inhaled deep, held it for a moment, then he really started to appreciate the sky.

"Oh, man. You're really missing out, cat"

Shaggy's never looked at the while high before.

"It's like, I can see in 4 dimensions man, and I can reach out and touch it. Dude, I could like reach out and just morph it into a big star and use it as a blanket, thats like a heated blanket"

"I see you have a way with words...." Puss paused for a moment, then initiated small talk "So, what's got you up here tonight?"

"Well, you might have seen me on the news and stuff with my friends, Mystery Incorporated, you know us, right?"

"How could I not, you were the weirdest kids in school"

"yeah, uh. so. yeah, you're right, we were pretty weird."

"I saw that you and Doobie had more scoobies than you could handle. I also saw your closeted friend tied up in some kind of bondage-cuck fusion getting degraded by your girlfriend."

"Hey! Fred's not gay.... And like, what's this talk about a girlfriend, dude?"

Puss chuckled. Shaggy smiled a bit, but couldn't tell if that was half serious or half joke, or both.

"So, your dog. Can I call him that? Your dog? Or is he a person?"

"Are you a person?"

"Good point."

Shaggy stared north.

"You saw the news, right? Or were you too high to notice?"

"The news..." Shaggy rubbed his head for a moment. "Right, yeah, i remember now. There was that uhhh... Science experiment... over north... right?"

"ah, actually you arent far off. But you really WERE too high, werent you?"

"Yeah, probably.." admitted Shaggy.

"A lab exploded. It's tragic, really."

Shaggy kept silent for a bit.

"Could i offer you a glass of leche?"

"You brought cups up this mountain? You brought MILK up this mountain? By the way, how are you not sweaty or tired or anything?"

"There's a trail on the other side of this mountain. But don't feel bad, it's really easy to miss when you're a junkie."

"Like, that's it, I'm gonna--"

Puss smirked.

"I'm gonna end you so hard right now I swear to god man, you're so incredibly dead right now. I'm not even kidding."

"A-... Are you serious?"

"Yes, man. Dead fucking serious."

Puss sat up, his pupils narrowing, his fur raised all along his back. Shaggy couldn't hold it anymore, his frown turned to a smirk.

Then Puss started laughing, and then soon enough they were both laughing hysterically.

"It's not even funny! That was the corniest shit I've ever heard in my LIFE!" wheezed Puss, wiping the tears from his eyes. Shaggy couldn't breathe.

The sky started turning orange, and they both stared into the sun, they talked until eventually they had to part ways. Shaggy didn't expect that to work, but whatever he did, he got puss to like him.

Shaggy went straight back to his shower and just tossed his dirty clothes onto the floor somewhere. It was now 7:00, past opening time. But Velma usually gets there before anyone else to open, shes a morning person.

After taking care of personal hygiene for the... what was it? Second time of the day? Shaggy opened his closet, and... He was out of identical outfits to wear, they were all piled up in a corner somewhere. So shaggy decided to mix it up a bit, he wore a green Hawaiian shirt, and some tan cargos. They both smelt like old clothes. Probably because they were.

However, maybe with this change of attire and healthy sleep schedule, he could gain back the great reputation he obviously had at school. Especially whipping this totally-rad and not beat up car.

He turned the key, the car cranked but wouldn't start. He turned it again.

"Damn rust bucket, start! You piece of shit!"

He flooded it. Now he'll have to walk to work, in the same sand he just came home from. All those showers and for what?

So through a mile or so of sand, sweat, and sheer determination. Shaggy's brain-map chimed 'Your destination is on your right.' Shaggy could see a line of people waiting for the bar to open. He pushed through the crowd.

"Okay, okay, bar's opening up now. Step back please."

Shaggy unlocked the door, and flicked the light switch on. The room felt cold, as if it was a windy spring day, which was odd. Shaggy threw some kindle in the fireplace to warm the place up a bit. Not even 5 minutes since he got there and there's already a full party in the bar, it's such a small town that people just set up all the menus and chairs on their own. Shaggy didn't mind.

Shaggy pushed through it for a few hours, serving as many people as he could as fast as he could. Shaggy had to cut the breakfast/lunch items off the menu due to shortage of staff, Shaggy was playing waiter, chef, and manager all at once. He's never been this stressed in his life. Though, there was that one physics test he took. That one really had him sweating.

Where are they, anyway? I wont be able to serve all these people on my own.

Like a miracle, they all showed up in the mystery machine. Except for Scooby.

"Hey Shag, sorry we're late. Had some van troubles." explained Fred

"Yeah... Wheres Scoob? Did he go home with you last night?"

"Oh--Yeah, he's still sleeping. I wouldn't bother him if I were you, you know how he gets when he's tired."

"I know more than any of you"

They both chuckled.

"Boy am I glad you guys are here, you just happened to pick the busiest day to ditch me!"

"No kidding, sorry Shaggy" said Daphne

"Yeah, sorry. Here, let me take over for you Norville" followed Velma

Shaggy put down the dish he was washing. "My name's not Norville, it's shaggy. so like, stop calling me that Velma!"

Fred ran the kitchen, Daphne waited, Velma washed dishes, and Shaggy ran the counter. Usually Scooby and Shaggy ran the kitchen, but Shaggy with no Scooby is like bananas without mustard, so he let Fred run it today.

It was finally peaceful now, until a newcomer wandered into the bar. He strangely resembled shaggy.

Fred bumped shaggy with his shoulder "Hey Shagster, look at that. It's you!"

His skin was pale, like a ghost.

He sat down at the counter, He wore a red, baggy shirt. His hair was a red-brown color, similar to Velma's, and he had a bent, roman nose. Firey red eyes. Shaggy took his order. 

"Pina colada. Extra Pina"

"Nice, that's a personal favorite of mine."

"New to this town?"

"Something like that."

Shaggy hummed while he made his drink, then he served the stranger.

"Like, what's your name, dude? Your outfit is totally groovy."

"My name is strange, i'd rather not say."

"Everythings been strange after that explosion. You notice that?"

The stranger chuckled and sipped his drink. Shaggy walked away.

Shaggy looked around for customers. Daphne was standing in the center of the room, completely still. Staring at the stranger.

"y-.. You okay Daph?"

Daphne turned away and continued taking orders

"That was.. something. D'ya see that Velma?"

Velma was staring at Shaggy. Directly at him.

Shaggy held her gaze for a moment. Something about it made his stomach drop, though he couldn't say why.

"Like, now this is getting weird, cut it out."

Velma continued washing the dishes again, still staring at Shaggy.

Shaggy leaned against the counter and watched them for a minute. Fred flipping something in the kitchen, Daphne taking a table's order, Velma had her back to him now. All of them moving around the bar exactly like they always did. He couldn't put his finger on what was wrong. Just that something was.

He walked over to Fred.

"Scooby must have been tired, huh? He's been sleeping all day since yesterday, are you sure he's not dead?"

Fred laughed, "Classic Scooby"

"Maybe I should go check on him, just to be sure--"

"--No. He's sleeping, we have work to do."

"Like, Fred, Scooby is more important than work. I need to know he's alright... Sorry, but I'm going to go check on him."

Shaggy turned to the door, Fred clamped his hand around Shaggy's wrist, cold, mechanically. 

"Hey! Let go! What the hell Fred?"

Fred explained once more,

"Scooby does not wish for you to visit him right now, it's best you leave him alone."

Shaggy stared at Fred's firm face for a moment, then loosened his stance. Fred let go.

"Whatever, dude. What's up with you guys this morning... Why are you being like this?"

Shaggy got no response. So he stayed silent the rest of his shift.

One by one the customers left, It was dark now. They closed together this night, They finished before Shaggy. They left him with the hardest job, cleaning the booths. Once he made it to the last booth, he turned the corner. There he was, the stranger. Just sitting in the booth.

Shaggy screamed and jumped back.

The stranger simply got up and left. Shaggy was breathing hard. He finished his shift and started the walk home. He thought about going to see Puss again, but he was thinking about his bed harder. 

As he blindly navigated through the pitch black desert to find the lab, he felt in his gut that something's watching him. He felt danger nearby, so he started walking faster.

He didn't want to look up. If he looked into the pitch black he'd start seeing things--dark figures, shadows, things moving around him. He tried to convince himself that the eerie noise he was hearing was just his brain trying to find something in nothing.

Shaggy couldn't help himself, he glanced up towards the distant lab, the faint wall sconce mounted to his garage door was the only light in the pitch black desert. Standing at his garage door, a dark, humanoid silhouette turned it's body at a slow, ghost-like pace.

In about 10 seconds, Shaggy arrived back at the bar, and fumbled to grab his keys, jamming them into the key hole and missing numerous times in a panicked motion, panting from the distance he sprinted.

As he flung himself into the building, he had to stop looking at his surroundings, and he felt the hairs on his neck raise, a shiver down his spine. And immediately shit the door (haha), locking it in place with the wooden barricade bar, and turning the lock to lock it. He turned around to look at his surroundings, Shaggy didn't like being in the bar at night time, he never did. But tonight it felt especially off.

Shaggy caught his breath for a second, placing his hands on his knees, muttering,

"What the fuck, what the fuck"

over and over. He sat down with his back against the door, and then got back up because what if it kicked down the door?

Shaggy looked around for a weapon, and then remembered Fred kept a crowbar in the basement to open crates. Great, yet another creepy place Shaggy had to go.

Shaggy held his breath and stepped down the old, creaky ladder. Reaching for the light, and flicking it on. A single light bulb on the ceiling, no cover. It was old, and dim. It was a warm incandescent color. It barely lit the room, and shadows were cast on every surrounding wall by the wooden crates stacked all around.

Shaggy scanned the room for his tool, and he saw a smudge of red in the shadows, sitting in between two crates, up against the wall. Shaggy creeped towards it cautiously, and ran to the exit. Half way up the ladder, Shaggy realized that if he went back up he'd risk the monster seeing him through a window. So Shaggy stayed in the creepy basement. Eventually he calmed himself down. He rolled himself a joint with his emergency weed supply hidden in a vent. He got hungry, so he opened up the freezer to grab some Eggo's.

Scooby and I would always pull all nighters in this basement, and survive on Eggo's. 

Shaggy looked over behind a crate in the corner of the room, Scooby hid there once to scare him. Shaggy's triple stacked waffle with Doritos and pickles ended up on Scooby's face. They laughed until they fell asleep. Curled up in a ball together on the dirty floor.

Maybe it was the weed, maybe these waffles were laced, maybe he's just completely crazy.

Shaggy licked his fingers after the waffle disappeared, and took the crowbar with him as he peeked from under the trapdoor. The coast was clear.

I have to go find Scooby, I know he's out there.

Shaggy stuffed some Cheez-its in his pocket, and bravely unlocked the door, staring into the complete and utter darkness. he exhaled and took the first step, he marched out onto the cool desert sand, and listened to all the bugs chirping, the street lamps humming. He heard a dog barking in the distance.

He looked around at all the houses, one house still had lights on. Some left their TV's on, and could be seen through the window.

He decided that he would check all of their sandwich spot's first, as those were the closest.

Then their smoke spots.

Then the pina colada spots. Those were the furthest.

after checking pina colada spot #2, Shaggy sat down on a nearby bench. His crowbar fell out of his hands into the sand. Shaggy shifted to lay on his side, the Cheez-its were reduced to crumbs the second he laid down. Shaggy ate em' anyway.

I'm just gonna rest my eyes for a bit. Gosh, this bench is comfy.

Chapter 3

I hav no mouth

2,294 words
Shaggy awoke in the bar, he was by the front door, or near it at least. The dimensions were wrong, the tables were too long, the counter didn't look right. In the back of the store, Scooby-Doo stood, at a seemingly infinite distance away from Shaggy.

Shaggy was too weak to run, let alone lift his head to look at Scooby. He crawled, he dragged himself across the floor. With each push, Scooby got further away, yet the perspective was impossible, and as Scooby got further away he appeared closer to Shaggy.

Shaggy, in sheer desperation, reached his measly hand out into the distance, reaching for Scooby. Scooby tried to say something--but his voice was underwater, or blocked by something. Shaggy heard wind in his ear, the lights in the bar were cool, not warm. They flickered. Next to Scooby, a door made of space and time opened.

Sand. Sand in his mouth, and eyes, and clothes. Shaggy spat it out into the desert sand, and stretched his sore back. Shaggy checked his watch. '9:44 A.M.' his shift starts at 7:00.

"oh shit."

Shaggy brushed the cheez it crumbs and sand off of his dirty clothes, ruffled his greasy hair and hauled ASS with his crowbar in hand, anybody who saw him probably ran too--in the opposite direction. Shaggy, looking like a mad man, panting, arrives at the bar to find that his customers have already opened the bar for him and were serving themselves drinks... 

Fuck, did i really leave the door open last night?

Velma had warned him before that if he did that one more time, there 'would be serious consequences'

Shaggy, anxious, pissed off, but also relieved that he didn't have to open today, walked into the cozy bar. He felt the eyes on him, and turned red inside. He sat the crowbar down somewhere where nobody would see it, and shoo' d the temporary bartenders from behind the counter.

The gang showed up late. Again, cold, emotionless.

Something is definitely off. I need to confront them, this has gone too far.

"Like, Fred, I'm not going to pretend that-"

"Shaggy, I need something from the freezer. Please grab me some waffles from the freezer. It's very urgent, move quickly now." Interrupted Velma

"No--What? Stop avoiding this! Like, What's your deal?!"

"Would you do it for a Scooby-Snack?" Velma pulled out the box from behind her and shook it.

Shaggy, watering at the mouth, nodded his head franticly.

Velma tossed the snack into his mouth. And Shaggy climbed down into the basement. He felt a shiver through his ankle as he stepped down the ladder. Shaggy found a note--a letter, addressed to him. From: 'Us'. Shaggy tore open the letter, and glanced over it.

Shaggy, we've talked about this too many times to count. You slept through your shift again. You lost Scooby. We can't keep doing this with you. Don't look for us.
— Velma, Fred, Daphne

Shaggy heard the mystery machine start outside, completely confused and distraught, he ran up the ladder and out the door, only to be met with.. dust.

"What's wrong with me? Why am I so susceptible to Scooby snacks? Scooby snacks. Scooby snacks!"

 Shaggy grabbed his crowbar and stormed fearlessly down into the basement, he marched up to the vault. Scooby and Shaggy had tried breaking into this vault on those bar-nights, brute forcing the code. 

Scooby... Scooby's gone. Scooby's gone and it's their fault! He was here with me, the night of the mystery! They knew, they knew and they didn't tell me

Shaggy remembered the cold hand that grabbed him, he remembered the bowl of noodles they never finished making. Shaggy smashed the vault, he smashed it again, again, again. probably too many times.

He took every box he could see, and Shaggy ran. Shaggy sweat. Shaggy collapsed into the sand, the boxes scattering across the desert floor. Shaggy stared at the sky.

The glowing blue moon in the east, the bright yellow sun in the west. a silhouette. a short silhouette, with a cavalier hat, approaching.

✦ ✦ ✦

Nothing. no darkness. Scooby is here, not literally. But Shaggy knew. Then, the door. It lures Shaggy in--Shaggy being the darkness. Shaggy embodied this place, and the door pulled him in. Was he him? What was he? There wasn't "what", there was no "where". The door carved into the nothingness, with a massive amount of light seeping out of it with anticipation. 

"Ah, you're awake. How'd you sleep?"

"I didn't."

There was an awkward silence for a minute or two, Shaggy groggily sat up in what he now knew to be a couch, and looked at the floor.

"Would you like a glass of leche?"

"Man, why do you always have that stuff?"

"Well." explained Puss, "It's kind of my signature thing. Just like you wouldn't be you without your dog." Said puss, ignorantly.

"Wait, i didnt mean-... Sorry...."

Shaggy said nothing, but took the glass of milk. Shaggy sat there for a good deal of time. It was cozy. A slow ticking of a clock could be heard, wind chimes outside. It was dawn--Puss left for work. Wherever that was.

Shaggy got up and looked around the house, it was small, tidy. Shaggy picked up a display rapier mounted on the wall, he handled it delicately, and examined the fine details of the sword.

When Puss finally came back, Shaggy had a response for Puss.

"You know, I didn't expect you to still be here. Don't you have somewhere to be?"

"Not anymore. I thought about what you said, and, you're right. I'm not myself without Scooby. But how do you know that you are yourself, if your only counterpart is milk? My point is, you seem lonely. Your house is mostly empty, you sit up on a mountain every night, and you-"

"Alright, alright. I get the point... I know because... I had my own friends once. We we're a trio, there was even a talking animal, similar to your group."

"You're a talking animal."

"Fair point... You're right that I'm lonely, but its better to pretend that I'm not. Besides... They are long gone, so I've moved on."

Shaggy listened to every word Puss said, stared for a minute, looked out the window... and left with his Scooby snacks. Puss went to go fix himself a glass of milk.

The lab had always been a comfort spot for Shaggy. The low hum of all the machinery, the flickery lights, the cold, hard floor.

Shaggy sat against the wall, his boxes of Scooby snacks all around him. He checked his watch.

Five O'clock on the dot. Shaggy took as many as he could, stuffing his face. He didn't care what happened next, he just hoped for it to be over.

The humming intensified, Shaggy drifted elsewhere. The stranger, he stood alone. In his palm, his friends, Daphne, Fred, Velma. His hand crushed them, shaggy watched as they exploded like grapes. He flew into the strangers eye, he saw.


The mystery machine, with Scooby. He was watching himself, like from a camera. The sunroof was open. It was cold, dark. They were in the woods. Something approaches from outside the vehicle.

"Raggy, it isn't safe here. Open the door."

It was pounding on the metal door, franticly. Shaggy stumbled over to the door, light seeping out of it. He flailed his arm, and hit the button. The blast door opened, everything stopped moving fast, and started slowing down. He stared into the doorway, a white thing, it rushed in, Shaggy was falling, turning. The humming slowed.

"Scooby...?"

 Shaggy fell.

He woke up later, in his bed. It had no garbage on it. He looked around, clean. spotless. no trash. He looked over at his desk, a white dog sat, stared calmly. 

Shaggy was too tired to scream.

"Who are you! Like, what are you doing in my house?"

It stood up from behind the computer screen. It had no mouth.

It had long, floppy brown ears. A big black nose. It was bipedal.

"Like, whatever."

Shaggy got up and collapsed instantly, his body felt like a bag of sticks and rocks. He picked up a box of scooby snacks, and shook it into his mouth. Nothing but crumbs. He threw the box in defeat. The dog was typing on his computer. Shaggy crawled over to his mini fridge and pulled out a case of beers, and he drank. bottle, after bottle. The dog just glared at him.

Shaggy just threw the empty bottles, they shattered on the hard floor. This crossed a line.

The white dog stood up, it was very angry. It was trying to gesture something to shaggy but shaggy no understand.

Shaggy dozed off to sleep.

When he woke up, his case of beers were gone. In front of him, a note. It read:

"I've hidden all your booze and marijuana, I refuse to live with a junkie."

"Hey, like, who said you're living here? not meee"

It turned the monitor towards shaggy, he typed something furiously. Shaggy squinted his eyes, and still couldnt read it.

The white dog pointed at the words, which didn't help. Then it turned the screen back and looked pissed off.

Shaggy's stomach growled. He opened the fridge, he saw some pickles, and went straight to it.

"This is like, totally not cool dude. You broke into my house AND you hid my weed? Fuck you."

The white dog typed at the speed of light, "I didn't break in--you opened the door you twat!"

"Oh, good. You're british too."

"And what's wrong with that?"

"Oh, nothing. I just hate british people."

The doglooked up at Shaggy, pure anger in its eyes. Shaggy opened the blast door to go upstairs, the doggrabbed his arm and flung him elsewhere and shit the door (HAHAHHAHA)

Shaggy fell on his ass and looked up at the dog with nothing but hate in every blood cell in his body, gave it the double finger and threw the jar of pickles at the dog.

It shattered and splattered all over the dog, the dog just pulled out a note and wrote on it "You're never getting your weed back. Never." the dog shoved the note in his face and stuck it on his forehead.

"NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO"

The next day, Shaggy woke up to the dog typing on the computer again.

Shaggy got up, and stood in front of the dog.

"Hey, dog. You're a dog right? so listen up dawg." Shaggy looked at the floor and sighed, "Look, we got off on the wrong foot. Like, I'm Shaggy" Shaggy held out his hand. Dog just stopped typing and glanced up at shaggy, then back at the screen and continued typing.

"I just- I cant win with you! God, what do you want from me man?--Dog!!"

Dog pointed at himself, then at the door, and made his fingers walk out the door.

"So why dont ya leave then?"

Dog started pawing the air like a cat, then made his fingers run, and put his arms up like he was on a roller coaster.

"I'm not following. What's your deal? You think you can just barge into MY house and tell ME what to do?"

It took out another note, "Something outside. unsafe. shelter"

"There's nothing outside, nothing but that damn sun. Not anymore at least."

"Monster."

"Yeah, you got one thing right. Look, Dog, I'm heading out to get a beer, don't touch my stuff--and get off of my computer!"

"I know about the folder." Dog wrote

"What? What folder, i don't know what you're talking about, like, I gotta go-bye!"

Dog tried to block the door, but he underestimated Shaggy's agility. Shaggy ran up the steps, and into the garage. What Shaggy discovered brought him to his knees.

"Dude where's my car?"

Dog pulled out note. "Where's your car dude?"

"Where's my car?"

Dog pulled out another note. "Dude where's your car?"

"Dude wheres my car?"

"Where's your car dude?" Dog was laughing now.

"Dude its not funny dude my car is gone! What'd you do with it?"

Dog shrugged. Shaggy went to the front door despite Dog's plees, and pulled it open.

"ZOIIIINKS!!!"

A grotesque, crab looking creature, nearly a foot tall, stood with four horrifying claws. That door didn't stay open for very long.

Dog had an "I told you so" look on his face, and Shaggy had a "Fuck you british scum" look on his face.

Shaggy did something productive instead. He searched for his hidden weed.

"If you don't tell me your name, I'll have to give you one, so you'd better speak up, Dog."

Dog looked around him, confused. Pointed at himself, and said with his finger "Who, me?"

"Oh, so you want to play like that. How do you like the name... Walter?"

Dog shrugged at the possibility

"Brian."

Dog shook his head firmly.

"Gertrude? How bout' that?"

Dog flipped him off.

"Snoopy...?"

Dog considered it, but shook his head.

"Dawg, with a g. How do you like them apples, Dawg?"

Dawg laughed to himself.

"You know, Dawg , you picked the wrong dude to mess with."

Dawg glared from across the room with his arms crossed. He knew Shaggy wouldn't find it.

"I know a thing or two about clues, Dawg." (Shaggy is full of shit, and he knows it)

Shaggy was rummaging through every cabinet, and one of them just wouldnt open, Shaggy pulled with all his might.

"Can I get some help with this?"

Dawg rolled his eyes and helped him, he knew it wasn't in there.

The cabinet exploded open with a hundred papers spewing out all over the once spotless floor, that Dawg had cleaned twice today already.

What's in your freezer?

952 words
Shaggy spat 3 crumpled peices of paper out of his mouth, and Dawg blew 3 out of his ginormous nose.

Shaggy grabs one of the papers and studies it. 

"ah, i see. this must be a clue!"

Dawg takes it out of his hands, flips it over, and hands it back to him.

"oh, its a.... uh.. i dont know what that is. look here! its signed 'novil', what a stupid name!"

 Dawg looks at him and waits for him to realize. 

"What?... Oh. It's me. I drew this? when? jeez, these must be from high school!"

Dawg points to the date.

"What..? that doesnt make sense.... I don't remember ever drawing these... That was yesterday, right?"

Dawg gets up and tells Shaggy to follow him over to the computer. His username was "Norville Rogers" still.

"You'll never guess my password, Dawg"

Shaggy watches him log in, flawlessly.

"Dude! How did you know my password? Are you like, psychic??"

Dawg opens up a notepad window. "It was just norville123, dumbass. And can you stop calling me dog?"

"I'm not calling you dog man, im calling you Dawg! With a g." Shaggy said with pride.

"Same fucking thing asshole. Just look at the date, hippie. You probably forgot because you're always on that good kush and alcohol."

"That's not possible... I fell asleep that day... and then... uh..."

"You see? You see what that stuff does to your head? You can't even remember a whole week of your life."

"No, dude, it's not that. It's these scooby snacks, hold on. Check this out, this is a diagram, these are blueprints!"

"Yeah, for what? This is just a bunch of rubbish."

"Look at the name, its a 'ZZZZinator FIVE BILLION???'"

"5b, you moron. there's 106 versions total, 1a-5b. quite simple, really."


"Right, I was totally joking. It says its short for 'Za Zaza Zadoobie' --woahhh!! Dawg, this thing is like a super high tech bong, it inhales, injects, feeds, sprays, inserts, and implants you with 'Zadoobie Ambrosia serum', we have to build this thing!"

"Yeah right, Im not exposing my body to '50% scob snac, 50% za, and 100% stoopid craZ', that's 200% potency drug, Norv, Are you 200% stupid crazy?"

"Hey! I said-" Shaggy's stomach cut him off.

"Uh oh, it's time for brunch, dawg."

"Don't call me Dog anymore!!! My name is Gromit!"

"Okay, let's eat, Doggy"

"Fuck you."

Shaggy opened his minifridge, it sits next to his bed in case he needs a midnight snack, which was every night. It was pretty gross inside, smudges and smears of god knows what, but Shaggy says it "adds flavor"

The fridge was completely full of delicious empty bottles of condiments, expired jars of weird ingredients, empty lunch meat packaging, moldy cheese, and an empty jug of milk.

"Damn it, Scooby. I told you not to do that..."

Gromit was already in the pantry, tossing all the junk on the floor. He emerged with nothing but a few DEFINETLY expired cans of soup.

"Like, those have probably been there since I was born. We have to take care of that crab soon or else we'll st-st-st-st-st STARVE!"

Gromit nodded his head and choked his chicken, i mean stroked his beard.

"grom you dont have a beard what are you strokin"

"idfk leave me alone its my life"

"Well, why dont we just kill it?"

Gromit shook his head.

"Why the hell not? I dont think we can unmask this thing"

Gromit typed at the computer "This thing was alive once, if we kill it we kill the chance of bringing it back."

"Well, why don't we just subdue it with the ZZZZinator 5billion so we can sneak right past it?" Gromit looked puzzled for a minute "Wait, are you actually considering it? So we can build the super-bong????" Shaggy asked, excitedly.

"No, but if we can capture this creature and find out whats wrong with it we could use your blue prints to build some sort of weapon.... From what I've seen, this is a virus, and we can only hope it's curable."

"Whatever, dog, As long as we get to eat soon." Shaggy rubbed his belly and it growled again. " If im not fed soon, well, you don't want to know what could happen. Last time this happened it did NOT end well.

Gromit shook his head while he laughed and covered his eyes

"Hold on, I know just how to trap it! Follow me!"

Shaggy led Gromit to the storage room where Fred kept his experiments. Shaggy pulled a tarp off of them. "Voilla!" (or violin idfk how its spelt let me cup)

Gromit looked around, a watermelon catapolt triggered by a doorbell, a doohickey with a claw machine attatched to a ceiling fan, a go go grabber gadget hooked up to a balloon that uses elastics to fling a cactus, a trip wire wired wired up wired to explosives.

Gromit said nothing, grabbed the tarp and left.

"Or, yeah, we could just wrap it up in a tarp like a dead body. Sure. No comically large boxing glove that punches you into a dog cage."

Gromit stopped, went back for the dog cage and left again.

"Like, what the hell are you going to do with that you freak? Not even scooby would degrade himself like that."

After a cool montage of planning, they were ready. at least Gromit was.

"Let me get this straight, you want ME to let this thing JUMP at me with its freaky claws and grossness, and then hit it out of the air with my crowbar?"

Gromit put up a thumbs up, and if he had a mouth he'd be smiling.
